title: PyPSA native standard line and transformer types

access: Already available through the installed PyPSA version
license_or_terms: MIT repository licence; preserve upstream attribution and pin distributed tables; no claim of OEM validation

mapping_scope: Selected source-backed fields in these families only; retain source/region/conditions and validate each admitted record.

title: pandapower basic standard types

mapping_scope: Selected source-backed fields in these families only; retain source/region/conditions and validate each admitted record.

title: California Solar Equipment Lists
geography: North America: United States/California; exported products require local applicability
access: Public lists; no account created or bulk extraction performed

mapping_scope: Ratings/efficiency and identity only where listed; not lifecycle, transfer, fault or GFM validation.

mapping_scope: Selected source-backed fields in these families only; retain source/region/conditions and validate each admitted record.

title: NLR wind turbine power-curve archive
license_or_terms: BSD-3-Clause root licence; inspect per-model cited origin and any separate notices before promotion
limitations: Curves have source and operating assumptions; not every turbine has thrust; no guarantee of current procurement availability or site-calibrated wake behavior

mapping_scope: Selected source-backed fields in these families only; retain source/region/conditions and validate each admitted record.

title: EPREL European product registry
geography: Europe: EU/EEA marketed regulated labelled products
format: Public portal/product sheets; public API service
access: Public comparison; API registration/key/terms need exact confirmation; no key requested
license_or_terms: EU2024/994 provides API subject to terms; public access is not blanket redistribution approval
limitations: Covers labelled categories, not all industrial equipment; nonpublic compliance documents excluded; seasonal metrics are not full physical performance maps
integration_mode: Authenticated approved API adapter or reviewed product-sheet upload, subset first
mapping_scope: Only regulated heating/cooling product groups and published rating conditions, not a full industrial map.

title: DOE Compliance Certification Database
access: Public model/basic-model search; no submission or purchase
license_or_terms: Government-hosted manufacturer submissions; precise dataset reuse/third-party notices need review
limitations: Current basic-model records submitted within past year; manufacturer-certified representations, DOE accuracy disclaimer; not full impedance/startup/dynamic parameters
integration_mode: Product-group importer with explicit test standard/basic-model identity; equipment evidence not blanket certification
mapping_scope: Transformer efficiency/basic ratings and motor power/efficiency; impedance, starting current and dynamic fields usually missing.

title: ENERGY STAR product datasets including UPS
publisher: US Environmental Protection Agency ENERGY STAR
geography: North America: US/Canada marketed product scope; verify exact model
parameter_families: UPS rated power and load-point efficiency
access: Public bulk/export/API documented; no model installed
license_or_terms: Record exact dataset rights and third-party notices before common redistribution; certification marks/endorsement are separate
limitations: UPS efficiency does not imply battery runtime, power quality, ride-through or aged capacity; preserve test loads and configurations

mapping_scope: UPS efficiency/nameplate/configuration subset; transfer/ride-through and battery autonomy absent.

title: Natural Resources Canada searchable motor/product lists

license_or_terms: Public source; exact export/redistribution conditions not verified

integration_mode: Canada-specific search/import feasibility; authorized selected records only
mapping_scope: Motor efficiency/nameplate subset only; no starting/acceleration or fault model inferred.
